purpose: Machine-readable implementation ordering/index. It does not authorize engineering; repository_contract.json remains authoritative for scope authorization.

integration_prerequisites: provider/transport harness for end-to-end tests; never a reference-provider authority dependency
restart_contract: durable replay/dedupe/security floors survive process restart; historical backup never rolls live authority/ratchet/prekey state backward
mutating logical operation identity is persisted before externally visible effect where its protocol requires retry/reconciliation
unknown network outcome remains pending/reconciling rather than becoming a new semantic operation
error_retry_contract: map transport/provider detail to stable semantic outcome+reason classes
stale/conflict requires authenticated refresh before a new semantic mutation
exact retry reuses the operation's existing EventID/request_id/replay identity where defined
forbidden_shortcuts: reference Home/provider becomes required Core runtime authority
wall clock/HLC chooses authority or security freshness
restore reactivates ratchet, bootstrap, revoked-device or stale provider authority
timeout is treated as definitive rejection after bytes may have been sent

integration_prerequisites: Core command/view harness; live provider is optional for UI implementation and required only for integrated scenarios
restart_contract: UI restart reconstructs pending/committed/rejected operations from Core; shell does not infer failure from process death
IdentityProfile view/cache/draft/adaptive-navigation state remains namespaced across restart
error_retry_contract: render Core outcome classes without promoting provider-specific text to semantics
PendingNetwork/PendingReconciliation never auto-originate a second semantic command
forbidden_shortcuts: UI writes protocol/key/provider authority state directly
theme/platform capability changes protocol/security meaning
adaptive navigation or optimistic UI asserts success/authority before Core commits

integration_prerequisites: Core/provider conformance client for end-to-end scenarios; provider remains replaceable
restart_contract: request_id idempotency state survives provider process restart for the advertised retry horizon
durable enqueue precedes success response/push wake where the operation promises storage
error_retry_contract: emit only registered HomeError codes with retryability matching the registry
moved is followed only after continuity proof verifies; unknown error behavior cannot be vendor-specific wire semantics
forbidden_shortcuts: provider acceptance becomes account/object authority
bearer capabilities appear in URL/cookie/log/analytics surfaces
provider-local generation checks replace client rollback floors

integration_prerequisites: frozen W1 group CDDL/registries/two-codec vectors and selected MLS runtime as required by V-004 before authorization
restart_contract: GroupControlIntent is durable before Commit publication; exact prepared Commit/Binding state survives retry
accepted MLS state, GroupControlState, canonical head and dedupe promote atomically or through an equivalent recovery journal
tentative/losing branches never release application/control effects; long-offline restart reconciles canonical state first
error_retry_contract: relay ack is transport progress, not group acceptance
uncertain publication exact-retries the prepared candidate only while its parent remains canonical
same-epoch loser is superseded; reductions rebase, non-reductions revalidate
forbidden_shortcuts: send application messages under an unaccepted tentative membership branch
reconstruct guessed equivalent MLS Commit bytes after prepared state is lost
timestamp/relay arrival/provider preference chooses the canonical same-epoch authority branch

integration_prerequisites: reviewed archive-encryption profile and vectors required by V-014 before authorization
restart_contract: partial export/import is staged and never publishes a manifest claiming objects that were not durably written/validated
restart resumes or discards staging without making archived authority/routing/security state live
error_retry_contract: import validation failure is terminal for the offending archive/object; repair requires changed input
interrupted copy may retry content-addressed/object-stable work without duplicating canonical events
forbidden_shortcuts: OMA-ENC-1-candidate ships as production crypto
archive restore overwrites newer live authority/security floors/provider capabilities

integration_prerequisites: content-pack/media conformance and parser/resource-limit evidence required by its gate
restart_contract: asset/content-pack activation is atomic; interrupted install leaves prior valid state active
content-addressed media cache retry never changes authenticated rendering identity
error_retry_contract: invalid/untrusted pack or asset is rejected/ignored according to its content contract rather than executed
network fetch retry does not invent a different expressive asset identity
forbidden_shortcuts: expressive/theme content becomes executable code or authority
live catalog/provider locator becomes rendering authority instead of immutable digest/BlobID

integration_prerequisites: MediaProvider/SFrame/WebRTC runtime evidence required by V-007
restart_contract: ephemeral media sessions may be re-established after restart; restart never resurrects stale call membership/key authority
durable call history/signaling events follow ordinary EventID/dedupe semantics where defined
error_retry_contract: route/media failure may re-negotiate through allowed routes without lowering E2EE/privacy policy
media transport success/failure never changes conversation membership authority
forbidden_shortcuts: SFU/TURN/provider becomes call membership or key authority
fallback disables required E2EE to regain reachability

integration_prerequisites: group authority/materialization core available; publication conformance remains separate
restart_contract: publication/control sequence high-water and conflict state survive restart
partially observed authority forks remain frozen until authenticated resolution rather than LWW recovery
error_retry_contract: stale/conflicting publication/control state requires reconciliation before new privileged mutation
duplicate publication/event IDs are idempotent; equivocation is a conflict
forbidden_shortcuts: timestamp/provider arrival order resolves authority forks
Space/Publication authority silently becomes account or Room universal owner authority

integration_prerequisites: service principal capability and information-flow conformance required by V-011
restart_contract: service jobs use stable scoped operation/event identities when retries can create external effects
restart does not widen service grants or recreate revoked installation credentials
error_retry_contract: external side-effect uncertainty remains pending/reconciling unless the remote operation has an idempotency contract
permission/egress denial is not auto-retried under a broader capability
forbidden_shortcuts: service principal masquerades as AccountPrincipal
plaintext-read capability implies network-egress or arbitrary room authority

integration_prerequisites: Wasm sandbox/capability feasibility required by V-010
restart_contract: plugin state/capability grants are versioned and restart does not silently restore revoked grants
host records pending side-effect identity before delegating an idempotent/retriable plugin action
error_retry_contract: trap/crash is not permission to retry non-idempotent external effects blindly
capability denial remains terminal until the user/authority changes the grant
forbidden_shortcuts: plugin executes outside declared sandbox/capability set
plugin/theme/content extension obtains raw protocol/key state by convenience

integration_prerequisites: real adapter/provenance evidence required by V-013
restart_contract: bridge loop-suppression/provenance and outbound operation identity survive restart for the supported retry horizon
restart never converts foreign state into native Account authorship
error_retry_contract: foreign-network unknown outcome is reconciled or retried only with that network's safe idempotency mechanism
bridge failure does not weaken native E2EE or provenance labeling
forbidden_shortcuts: bridge endpoint is represented as native AccountPrincipal
unknown external-send outcome causes duplicate forwarding with a fresh logical identity without reconciliation

integration_prerequisites: ADR-0157 LanDeliveryProfile-v1 runtime/two-client evidence required by V-024
restart_contract: LAN route/session/replay state follows ordinary sealed-delivery crash semantics; local receipt does not falsely become configured storage durability
ephemeral rendezvous/link state is regenerated rather than restored as durable authority
error_retry_contract: LAN failure/failover preserves the higher-level EventID while route reseal uses the fresh route-bound delivery id required by sealed delivery
unavailable local channel binding reports local_delivery unavailable rather than falling back to weaker browser semantics
forbidden_shortcuts: LAN presence/rendezvous establishes identity or relationship authority
clear-sender or weaker browser-only delivery path
local transfer changes BlobID/ciphertext_digest identity
